summary: Circumstantial evidence murder case; no recovery of dead body; motive absent; last seen theory inconsistent across witness statements; extra-judicial confession retracted; recovery from open place not exclusive knowledge; corpus delicti presumption without DNA verification; chain of circumstances incomplete; conviction requiring proof beyond reasonable doubt not met.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000
final_judgment: The Supreme Court set aside the conviction and acquitted the appellant due to insufficient and inconsistent circumstantial evidence.
